firmware.title: Orion-128 (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: The Orion-128 home computer (M1, M3 with disks, Z80 Card II). Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
